_doc: Unified item registry for Core Warden. Every item that exists in the game — craftable, tradeable, NPC prop, structure, quest reward. Other files (recipes.json, shop-inventories.json, loot-tables.json) reference item IDs from this registry.

_schema.name: Display name
_schema.category: One of: raw, refined, component, consumable, equipment, structure, deployable, lore-fragment, tool, weapon, document, sacred, authority, instrument, container, crafted, quest
_schema.playerObtainable: true = can enter player inventory; false = NPC-only prop
_schema.slot: (optional) Equipment slot: weapon | body | offhand | back
_schema.source: (optional) How player obtains: mining, gathering, hunting, loot, etc.
_schema.biomes: (optional) Where it spawns in the world
_schema.associatedRole: (optional) NPC role that uses this item
_schema.placeSpriteKey: (optional) Phaser texture key for placed structure
_schema.iconDescription: (optional) PixelLab prompt for generating missing icons
